channel.title: Wire — Engineering
channel.description: Engineering from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: GrabMart data for faster disease outbreak detection
item.description: Abstract Retail purchases can supplement clinical surveillance because changes in demand for some over-the-counter (OTC) products may appear before confirmed case reports. (1 source: grab)

item.title: Presentation: How Eve Online Leverages Head Based Sampling to Observe "Fun"
item.description: Nicholas Herring shares how EVE Online tackles distributed tracing and observability across a 20-year-old MMO architecture. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Filter, reshape, and redact logs before export with Transformers
item.description: Logpush now supports Transformers, allowing teams to filter, redact, and reshape log streams using SQL before export. (1 source: cloudflare)

item.title: GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: How to teach Copilot about your codebase
item.description: Learn how to add custom instructions and skills to your repository, use custom agents, and connect MCP servers like Playwright. (1 source: githubblog)
